title: Old friends in New Orleans and the upcoming festival
summary: Alvin Alcorn, Percy and Willie Humphrey and Freddie Coleman are still there; he hopes to attend the 1985 festival.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, we appreciate you being around, George. And, well, it's interesting. Today you're, what, 73? No, I'm 71. 72? 71. God, the time is going by slowly. At any rate, it's great. Well, I hope you've been back to New Orleans. I hope you get back there again. And, you know, maybe you'll be at the New Orleans Jazz Festival this year. There's still some of your friends down there that are still playing. Yes. Who's still around down there?
Well, I understand Alvin is still living.
Alcorn. I never did play with Alvin. But Alvin was always around when I needed help. Seemed like he would come in and out. And he helped me also.
Yeah. That's Alvin Alcorn, is it? Alcorn. A-L-C-O-R-N, yeah.
Right. And, of course, Percy Humphries is still playing.

Willie Humphrey. And the funny thing about it, I didn't know when they sent out these invites for the old musicians around there, I was never thought about, I guess, by not, by it was 30 some years from the time I left until the time I got back.

But I understand there was other musicians around that have these invites to attend the festival at that time, sort of a reunion. So, this year, or 1985, I'm looking forward to going down there. Yeah. Invited or not.

Well, they probably forgot your address, George. Oh, that is true. You know, you can't disappear for 35, 40 years, right? That is true. Well, we'll make sure they get your address, you know? That is true. Okay.
Because a lot of the guys, I understand, is dying, and there's not very many left during that era. And those that is around us in the 70s, some of them in the 80s, possibly in the 90s.
